messages:
sarah: FYI I'm seeing a flurry of user sign-in errors this morning after the IdP cert rotation. Errors are SAML Assertion: Audience mismatch and SCIM provisioning is having 409 conflicts. Can someone who owns the GSuite config take a look?

dan: I'm on it. Quick q — did we change the SP entityID when we migrated the console domain last week? audience mismatch usually means the assertion 'Audience' doesn't equal our SP entityID.

sarah: We did update the console URL for the vanity domain, but I thought the metadata update was applied. I only see one metadata file in the upload bucket.

kevin: Looking at the logs from the SAML proxy, assert.aud="https://auth.redwood-inference.com/saml" but our SP expects "https://console.redwood.ai/saml". That explains the mismatch. The metadata in the idp UI still points to the old console URL.

ashley: Oh — we changed the public console name for marketing. Did that change the running service's expected SP? We pinned the SP in k8s config to console.redwood.ai two weeks ago.

dan: Two fixes: 1) update IdP metadata with new SP entityID OR 2) Configure the SP to accept both audience values temporarily. Option 2 is faster for emergency.

sarah: Let's accept both for now. Kevin can you patch the proxy to allow the old and new audience values and push a short-lived config? Make sure it's behind a feature flag.

kevin: Patching now. Patch adds allowed_audiences: ["https://console.redwood.ai/saml","https://auth.redwood-inference.com/saml"] and hot-reloads. Deploying to prod-canary.

scim-bot: SCIM sync job 2025-09-14T09:08:12Z failed: 409 Conflict - User exists but matched by externalId mismatch. Endpoint /scim/v2/Users returned: {"detail":"externalId mismatch","status":409}"

ashley: That SCIM 409 is probably because attribute mapping changed during the domain rename. GSuite might be sending user.email_verified=false or not sending externalId. We require externalId to match onboarding id.

dan: In Google Workspace SCIM app, check attribute mappings: make sure 'externalId' is mapped to 'employeeId' or the custom id we use. Also set "Send Email Verified" to true so we don't get partial profiles.

sarah: Also audit logs — we need an entry for who rotated the cert and who updated metadata. Can we ensure these events are captured in our audit log (Cloud Audit + Console Events)?

kevin: The metadata upload process writes an entry to infra-audit S3 and also emits an event to our audit-log service. I don't see the 'metadata-update' event for today in our ES index. Maybe the web UI upload failed and someone did a manual change at the IdP.

oncall: @dan can you check Okta/Google admin audit? If the IdP metadata was changed directly in the IdP console it will show who.

dan: I pulled the Google Admin audit: change was made by "marketing-ops@redwood.ai" via SAML app settings at 09:05 UTC. That explains the mismatch — not an infra automated deploy.

sarah: Noted. We'll treat this as a policy gap — non-sec teams shouldn't update SP metadata. Filing a quick remediation: 1) revert to org-change flow (only sec+infra can change metadata), 2) add guardrail in console UI to require approval for SP entity changes.

ashley: For SCIM, I can add a mapping fallback: if externalId missing, match by primary email but require email_verified=true. Will that break older users?

kevin: Add a dry-run flag for the SCIM fallback and run for 24 hours, log mismatches. We can then run a catchup job.

scim-bot: SCIM sync dry-run started: job_id=job_20250914_dryrun_77. Will report in #eng-ops after 2h.

sarah: Two extra asks: KMS-integrations — several customers reported KMS key rotation errors during the outage. Any correlations?

kevin: KMS errors look independent — those were failing when service tried to decrypt stored session keys. I saw a spike at 09:06 UTC but after patching audience it's steady. Need to verify that the cert rotation didn't cascade to the key access policy.

dan: I will check key policies and service account bindings. If the IdP change caused tokens to be reissued, some services may have attempted actions without the right SA permissions.

ashley: For immediate remediation: Kevin's audience-patch is live, scim dry-run started, dan will audit IdP changes and KMS bindings, and sarah will open a post-incident doc with action items and a compliance ticket to restrict metadata edits.

sarah: Thanks all — please drop updates here. If anything critical, page the on-call. :lock:
